plan.title: Capstone assessment never names the WI-NNN exhaustion bound

narratives.Description: The capstone assessment tells the learner to implement the visible work-item contract and never names the WI-NNN exhaustion bound: Task 2 is silent, the CAP.2 hints stay at the evidence layer, and the green.json row names only WI-001. scripts/verify-capstone.mjs stays green whether or not that sentence is present, so the naming can be removed without any gate noticing. The accepted remedy makes the assessment Task 2 paragraph the naming carrier for the same 999 and RangeError bound issue 36 pins, and pins that sentence on the capstone verifier.
narratives.Overview:
Leftover from [deftai/directive-training#36](https://github.com/deftai/directive-training/issues/36) design-critique Stop 1 assessment-naming conjunct.

Stop 1 `P2` named three learner-facing surfaces. This issue is the assessment surface only. Lab and explained-solution naming of the `WI-NNN` bound stay on #36.

Pain-audit [5761056035](https://github.com/deftai/directive-training/issues/36#issuecomment-5761056035) independently supported `relieves: P1` and blocked `relieves: P2` because the assessment can stay silent.

## Unmet surface

At dispatch SHA `0cb9925d561733ea0907a8f1b450a61416ba1fd6`:

- `assessments/capstone-end-to-end.md` Task 2 tells the learner to implement "the visible work-item contract"
- CAP.2 hints are evidence-layer hints
- the `green.json` evidence row names `WI-001` and does not name `999`, exhaustion, or `RangeError`
- zero hits for `WI-NNN`, `999`, `exhaust`, or `RangeError` in that assessment

## Required remainder

- Assessment Task 2 / CAP.2 names the same monotonic refusal once a collection already holds `WI-999`, even when lower identifiers are free, and the same `RangeError` phrase the #36 Bound-remedy pins.
- The `green.json` evidence row stays compatible with that contract.
- `scripts/verify-capstone.mjs` asserts that assessment sentence. Do not skip the assessment with "where it carries the contract."

## Suggested acceptance criteria

- A learner reading only the assessment can state the `WI-NNN` bound and the exhaustion throw without inventing it.
- `node scripts/verify-capstone.mjs` fails if that assessment sentence is removed.
narratives.UserStory: As a learner reading only the capstone assessment, I want Task 2 to state the WI-NNN bound and the exhaustion throw, so that I can implement the contract without inventing behavior the material never names.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Recut the assessments/capstone-end-to-end.md Task 2 (CAP.2) paragraph that currently says implement only the visible work-item contract so it names the monotonic refusal once a collection already holds WI-999, even when lower identifiers are free, and the RangeError throw.
2. Copy the exact message string from the issue-36-landed lab Task 2 green-list bullet and both solution listings; do not author a second message here.
3. Leave the CAP.2 progressive hints at the evidence layer and keep the Required evidence manifest green.json row as WI-001 / Capture capstone evidence / open.
4. Extend scripts/verify-capstone.mjs so the extracted cap2Task must contain that sentence, and add a changedCopy mutation in scripts/verify-capstone.test.mjs that removes it and fails.
5. Do not land lab or explained-solution naming here; those ride issue 36.

charter: open critique · round 1 fresh critic · ceiling 5763246313 · dispatch-sha `1b52363c9fa210180a71e3626f250bd3c5569842` · arc-mode: no-ingest

## Verdict

The assessment is silent on the `WI-NNN` bound at this SHA, and `scripts/verify-capstone.mjs` stays green through that silence. The leftover can bind after Stop 1 `P1` and the required remainder name the same carrier, and after this issue quotes the `RangeError` message it copies.

## Re-verification of the triage's anchors

Checks were re-run at dispatch SHA `1b52363c9fa210180a71e3626f250bd3c5569842`. Line cites on Stop 1 and on the issue body were treated as claims. In-envelope input is the issue body plus comment `5763246313`.

| Anchor claim | Result | Check run |
|---|---|---|
| Assessment Task 2 says implement "the visible work-item contract" | holds | `### Task 2 — Produce green and diagnose the broader gate (\`CAP.2\`)` contains that phrase once and names no identifier bound |
| CAP.2 hints stay at the evidence layer | holds | Hint 1 names red/tests/literal/aggregate; Hint 2 names `red.json`, `green.json`, `focused.json`, `literal.json`, `aggregate-failure.json`; Hint 3 names the seeded `review:evidence` stop. Zero `WI-NNN` / `999` / `exhaust` / `RangeError` |
| The `green.json` evidence row names `WI-001` only | holds | Required evidence manifest row: add returns `WI-001 / Capture capstone evidence / open`. That is the only `WI-001` in the assessment |
| Zero `WI-NNN`, `999`, exhaustion, or `RangeError` in the assessment | holds | Token counts on `assessments/capstone-end-to-end.md`: `WI-NNN` 0, `WI-999` 0, `999` 0, `RangeError` 0, `exhaust` 0, `WI-001` 1 |
| `verify-capstone.mjs` does not fail if that assessment sentence is absent | holds | `node scripts/verify-capstone.mjs` prints `ok (36 artifacts, 0 missing)`, exit 0. `/tmp` probe A replaces `visible work-item contract` and still exits 0. Probe B inserts a `WI-999` / `RangeError` sentence and still exits 0. Probe C replaces the `WI-001` evidence-row clause and still exits 0. The script extracts `cap2Task` and requires retained `red.json`; it does not require an identifier-bound sentence |
| #36 already specifies the bound this leftover names | holds for type and 999 rule; message unquoted | Bound-remedy on successor lean 5761685555: keep `/^WI-\d{3}$/`; refuse add once a collection holds `WI-999` even when lower identifiers are free; throw `RangeError` with one stable phrase; leftover 38 is the assessment naming surface only. That comment does not quote the message string. This SHA's lab still has one `WI-NNN` (highest numeric suffix) and zero `999` / `exhaust` / `RangeError`. Supplied test mentions `WI-NNN` only on `completeWorkItem` with a bad id |

P1 and P2 both still hold on the tree.

## Inventory

No new mechanism.

- Assessment Task 2 already tells the learner to implement the visible work-item contract.
- Lab Task 2 (`CAP.2`) already has a five-bullet green list. #36 Bound-remedy 5761685555 already lands the lab bullet there.
- Assessment CAP.3 Hint 3 and the `review-resolution.json` evidence row already carry a product phrase (`duplicates an existing work item`). The verifier pins the matching throw on the solution listing.
- `scripts/verify-capstone.mjs` already extracts assessment Task 2 as `cap2Task` and uses `assert.match` / `includes` on `assessmentPath`.
- `scripts/verify-capstone.test.mjs` already uses `changedCopy("assessments/capstone-end-to-end.md", …)` for fail-if-removed cases.
- Approved `training.capstone.learning-experience` `fileScope` already includes `assessments/capstone-end-to-end.md`, `scripts/verify-capstone.mjs`, and `scripts/verify-capstone.test.mjs`.

## F1 — blocks-the-design: Stop 1 P1 and the required remainder name different carriers

**Evidence.** Stop 1 `P1` names three assessment surfaces that never name `WI-NNN` / `999` / exhaustion / `RangeError`: Task 2, CAP.2 hints, and the `green.json` evidence row. The because-clause is that a learner reading only the assessment cannot state the bound.

The required remainder names one carrier: "Assessment Task 2 / CAP.2 names the same monotonic refusal". It then says the `green.json` evidence row stays compatible. CAP.2 hints are absent from that list. Measured today, "compatible" on that evidence row is the empty-collection probe `WI-001 / Capture capstone evidence / open`, which still omits `999` / `RangeError`. CAP.2 hints omit them too.

**Failure mode.** A successor map that records `relieves: P1` after only Task 2 gains the sentence leaves two of the three P1 surfaces silent. That is the same three-surface hole that leftovered this issue from #36. Path-1 would treat `P1` as covered while a learner who follows the CAP.2 hint ladder or the evidence-manifest row still cannot state the bound from those surfaces.

**Disposition consequence.** Align `P1` with the remainder, or widen the remainder to `P1`. Alignment recuts `P1` to the assessment Task 2 paragraph as the naming carrier, and records CAP.2 hints plus the `green.json` row as keep-silent evidence. Widening adds remainder items that CAP.2 Hint 3 (or an evidence-row clause) names the same 999 / `RangeError` sentence. Until that match exists, `relieves: P1` cannot bind.

## F2 — sharpens-framing: quote the RangeError message this remainder copies

**Evidence.** The remainder asks for "the same `RangeError` phrase the #36 Bound-remedy pins". Successor lean 5761685555 says throw `RangeError` with one stable phrase and pin that type and message on the lab, both listings, Valid alternatives, the supplied test, and `scripts/verify-capstone.mjs`. It does not quote the message. At this SHA the solution `RangeError` strings are `work item ` + id + ` not found` and `title duplicates an existing work item`. There is no exhaustion message in the tree.

**Failure mode.** Two implementers pick two messages. Assessment Task 2 then disagrees with the lab bullet and the worked listings, which is the original cross-surface naming hole.

**Disposition consequence.** Quote the message on this issue, or say this remainder copies the exact string from the #36-landed lab Task 2 bullet and both solution listings once that harvest is on `origin/<default>`. Type `RangeError` and the monotonic 999 rule are already specified.

## F3 — sharpens-framing: name the assessment Task 2 paragraph

**Evidence.** Lab heading: `### Task 2 — Preserve red/green and layered checks (`CAP.2`)`. Assessment heading: `### Task 2 — Produce green and diagnose the broader gate (`CAP.2`)`. #36 Bound-remedy already lands "the learner-facing bullet on `labs/capstone-end-to-end.md` Task 2 (`CAP.2`) green list". This issue's unmet surface is `assessments/capstone-end-to-end.md`. "Task 2 / CAP.2" locates both documents.

**Failure mode.** An implementer lands the lab green-list bullet (already on #36) and treats CAP.2 as done. Assessment Task 2 still says only "the visible work-item contract".

**Disposition consequence.** Name the assessment heading `### Task 2 — Produce green and diagnose the broader gate (`CAP.2`)` and the paragraph that currently says implement only the visible work-item contract. Keep leftover 38 as that paragraph plus the `verify-capstone.mjs` assertion and the existing `changedCopy` test in `scripts/verify-capstone.test.mjs`.

## F4 — footnote: `green.json` is the helper evidence described by the assessment table row

There is no authored `green.json` in this repository. The remainder's "green.json evidence row" is the Required evidence manifest row whose add probe returns `WI-001 / Capture capstone evidence / open`. Probe C shows that row is currently unasserted. Compatibility means that empty-collection probe stays `WI-001`. The exhaustion comparison stays the #36 supplied test.

## F5 — footnote: this SHA is still pre-#36-land

Lab token counts at this SHA: `WI-NNN` 1, `999` 0, `RangeError` 0. That is leftover-before-lab-land, expected for an assessment-only remainder.

## Road not taken

The strongest rejected reading is to follow CAP.3: put the phrase in a hint and an evidence row, and leave assessment Task 2 as freeze-rules that point at the lab.

**Steelman.** Assessment purpose already says it does not measure memorized wording. Task 3 body does not quote `RangeError`; Hint 3 and the `review-resolution.json` row carry `duplicates an existing work item`. After #36 lands the lab bullet, a learner who uses lab plus assessment is not inventing exhaustion. Assessment Task 2 can keep pointing at the visible work-item contract.

**Flip.** I would take that reading if Stop 1 `P1` named only invent-behavior, or if this leftover required no assessment sentence. Stop 1 names three assessment surfaces, and the remainder requires an assessment sentence with a verifier pin. That is a stricter pin than CAP.3, and it uses the existing `cap2Task` / `changedCopy` mechanism.
